title: "Publications"
page-layout: full

```{r data, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
library(rentrez)
library(xml2)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(reactable)
library(tm)
library(topicmodels)
library(tidytext)
library(ggwordcloud)
library(visNetwork)


query <- '(Jacob Vogel[Auth]) OR (Vogel JW[Auth])'


pmids <- entrez_search(db='pubmed', term=query, retmax=500)$ids
publications <- entrez_summary(db='pubmed', id=pmids)
raw_xml <- entrez_fetch(db="pubmed", id=pmids, rettype="xml")

xml_data <- read_xml(raw_xml)
records <- xml_find_all(xml_data, ".//MedlineCitation")
papers <- xml_find_all(records, ".//Article")

extract_authors <- function(record) {
  lastname <- record %>% xml_find_all(".//LastName") %>% xml_text()
  initials <- record %>% xml_find_all(".//Initials") %>% xml_text()
  paste(lastname, initials, collapse = ", ")
}
extract_first_two <- function(s) {
  elements <- str_split(s, ",", simplify = TRUE)[1, ]
  paste(elements[1:min(2, length(elements))], collapse = ", ")
}
extract_last <- function(s) {
  elements <- str_split(s, ",", simplify = TRUE)[1, ]
  elements[length(elements)]
}

titles <- papers %>% xml_find_all(".//ArticleTitle") %>% xml_text() %>% str_trim()
authors <- sapply(papers, extract_authors)
journal <- papers %>% xml_find_all(".//Title") %>% xml_text() %>% str_trim() %>% str_squish()
pub_date <- papers %>% xml_find_all(".//PubDate") %>% xml_text() %>% ymd(truncated = 2)
pub_type <- papers %>% xml_find_first(".//PublicationType") %>% xml_text()
abstract <- papers %>% xml_find_first(".//Abstract") %>% xml_text()
article_records <- xml_find_all(xml_data, ".//PubmedArticle")
record_pmid <- article_records %>% xml_find_first("./MedlineCitation/PMID") %>% xml_text()
record_doi <- article_records %>% xml_find_first(".//ArticleIdList/ArticleId[@IdType = 'doi']") %>% xml_text()


filt_year <- ymd('2020', truncated = 2)
pub_data_org <- tibble(Title = titles, 
                       Author = authors, 
                       Journal = journal, 
                       Date = ymd(pub_date, truncated = 2), 
                       Type = pub_type, 
                       Abstract = abstract, 
                       pmid = record_pmid,
                       doi = record_doi)


records <- xml_find_all(xml_data, ".//PubmedArticle")
extract_references <- function(paper) {
  refs <- paper %>% xml_find_all(".//ArticleId[@IdType = 'pubmed']") %>% xml_text()
  return(refs)
}

paper_references <- lapply(records, extract_references)


x <- pub_data_org %>%
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(auth_split = list(str_split_1(Author, ",\\s*"))) |> 
  pull(auth_split)

jake_log <- c()
for (i in seq_along(x)) {
  first_auth <- grepl("Vogel", head(x[[i]], 3))
  last_auth <- grepl("Vogel", tail(x[[i]], 3)) 
  jake_log_i <- sum(c(first_auth, last_auth))
  jake_log <- c(jake_log, jake_log_i>0)
}

pub_data_org <- pub_data_org |> mutate(main_auth = jake_log)

ref_data <- pub_data_org %>% mutate(refs = paper_references) |> 
  filter(Date > filt_year, main_auth) %>% 
  unnest(refs)  

pub_data_org <- pub_data_org |> filter(Date > filt_year, main_auth) 

# Second source: Jake's ORCID profile. Works with a DOI that PubMed does not
# return (mostly preprints) are added to the table, with authors, journal or
# preprint server, date and abstract from Crossref, and the same rule as above
# (Vogel among the first or last three authors, 2020 onwards). If ORCID or
# Crossref cannot be reached the build stops, so the page is never published
# with papers missing.
orcid_id <- "0000-0001-6394-9940"

read_json_url <- function(u) {
  jsonlite::fromJSON(paste(readLines(url(u, headers = c(Accept = "application/json")), warn = FALSE),
                           collapse = ""),
                     simplifyVector = FALSE)
}

orcid_works <- read_json_url(paste0("https://pub.orcid.org/v3.0/", orcid_id, "/works"))$group
orcid_dois <- map_chr(orcid_works, function(w) {
  ids <- keep(w[["external-ids"]][["external-id"]], ~ .x[["external-id-type"]] == "doi")
  if (length(ids)) tolower(ids[[1]][["external-id-value"]]) else NA_character_
})
orcid_dois <- setdiff(unique(na.omit(orcid_dois)), tolower(na.omit(record_doi)))

crossref_row <- function(doi) {
  m <- read_json_url(paste0("https://api.crossref.org/works/", URLencode(doi, reserved = TRUE)))$message
  date_parts <- unlist(m$published$`date-parts`[[1]])
  tibble(Title = str_squish(unlist(m$title)[1]),
         Author = paste(map_chr(m$author, ~ paste(.x$family %||% "",
                                                  str_remove_all(.x$given %||% "", "[^A-Z]"))),
                        collapse = ", "),
         Journal = unlist(m$`container-title`)[1] %||% m$institution[[1]]$name %||% m$publisher,
         Date = ymd(paste(c(date_parts, 1, 1)[1:3], collapse = "-")),
         Type = m$type,
         Abstract = str_remove(str_squish(str_remove_all(m$abstract %||% NA_character_, "<[^>]+>")),
                               "^(?i)abstract\\s*"),
         pmid = NA_character_,
         doi = doi)
}

orcid_data <- map_dfr(orcid_dois, crossref_row) |>
  filter(Date > filt_year) |>
  mutate(main_auth = map_lgl(str_split(Author, ",\\s*"),
                             ~ any(grepl("Vogel", head(.x, 3))) || any(grepl("Vogel", tail(.x, 3))))) |>
  filter(main_auth) |>
  # skip preprints whose published version PubMed already lists (same title,
  # ignoring capitals and punctuation), and keep one copy of repeated preprints
  mutate(title_key = str_to_lower(str_remove_all(Title, "[^[:alnum:]]"))) |>
  filter(!title_key %in% str_to_lower(str_remove_all(titles, "[^[:alnum:]]"))) |>
  arrange(desc(Date)) |>
  distinct(title_key, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(-title_key)

edge_list <- ref_data %>% filter(Type != 'Preprint') %>% 
  select(pmid, refs) %>% rename(Paper = pmid, Reference = refs) %>% 
  filter(Reference %in% Paper) %>% 
  filter(Paper != Reference) %>% 
  inner_join(pub_data_org, join_by(Paper == pmid)) %>% 
  mutate(Paper = Title) %>% 
  select(Paper, Reference) %>% 
  inner_join(pub_data_org, join_by(Reference == pmid)) %>% 
  mutate(Reference = Title) %>% 
  filter(Date > filt_year) %>% 
  select(Paper, Reference)

graph_titles <- unique(c(edge_list$Paper, edge_list$Reference))

docs <- pub_data_org %>%
  filter(Type != "Preprint", Title %in% graph_titles) %>%
  group_by(Title) %>%
  summarise(
    Abstract = paste(na.omit(Abstract), collapse = " "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(text = paste(Title, Abstract))

corpus <- VCorpus(VectorSource(docs$text)) %>%
  tm_map(content_transformer(tolower)) %>%
  tm_map(removePunctuation) %>%
  tm_map(removeWords, c(stopwords("english"),
                        'discussion','method','methods','participants','used',
                        'individuals','mean','association','included','among',
                        'associated','study','higher','compared','measures','showed',
                        'results','using','human','analysis','including','can','show',
                        'identified','two','patients','result','objective','abstract','disease')) %>%
  tm_map(stripWhitespace)

dtm <- DocumentTermMatrix(corpus)

num_topics <- 4
lda_model <- LDA(dtm, k = num_topics, method = "Gibbs", control = list(seed = 2024))
doc_topics <- tibble(Title = docs$Title, group = topics(lda_model))

nodes_lookup <- tibble(name = graph_titles)

# The four topics are found automatically from the abstracts. Each one gets the
# colour of the Research page theme (PET, fMRI, Omics, AI) whose key words it
# shares most, so a colour means the same thing on both pages. The soft colours
# are the ones in projects.qmd (used for the network dots); the words use a
# darker shade of the same colour so they stay readable on white.
research_themes <- tibble(
  theme = c("PET", "fMRI", "Omics", "AI"),
  soft  = c("#FFAABB", "#77AADD", "#44BB99", "#EEDD88"),
  words = list(
    c("tau", "taupet", "pet", "amyloid", "amyloidbeta", "spread", "tracer", "deposition"),
    c("connectivity", "functional", "fmri", "networks", "network", "brain", "cognitive", "regions"),
    c("proteins", "protein", "proteomics", "proteomic", "plasma", "biomarkers", "biomarker", "genes", "genetic", "molecular"),
    c("model", "models", "learning", "machine", "subtypes", "subtype", "progression", "data", "deep", "clinical")
  )
)

topic_beta <- tidy(lda_model, matrix = "beta") %>%
  group_by(topic) %>% slice_max(beta, n = 15) %>% ungroup()

# score every topic against every theme, then hand out the best pairs first
scores <- expand_grid(topic = seq_len(num_topics), theme = seq_len(nrow(research_themes))) %>%
  mutate(score = map2_dbl(topic, theme, function(tp, th)
    sum(topic_beta$beta[topic_beta$topic == tp & topic_beta$term %in% research_themes$words[[th]]]))) %>%
  arrange(desc(score))
theme_of_topic <- rep(NA_integer_, num_topics)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(scores))) {
  if (is.na(theme_of_topic[scores$topic[i]]) && !(scores$theme[i] %in% theme_of_topic))
    theme_of_topic[scores$topic[i]] <- scores$theme[i]
}
message("Topic -> theme: ", paste(seq_len(num_topics), research_themes$theme[theme_of_topic], sep = "=", collapse = ", "))

topic_soft <- setNames(research_themes$soft[theme_of_topic], as.character(seq_len(num_topics)))
topic_colors <- setNames(rgb(t(col2rgb(topic_soft)) * 0.55, maxColorValue = 255),
                         as.character(seq_len(num_topics)))

nodes <- nodes_lookup %>%
  left_join(doc_topics, by = c("name" = "Title")) %>%
  mutate(group = replace_na(group, 0L),
         color.background = unname(topic_soft[as.character(group)]),
         color.border = unname(topic_colors[as.character(group)]),
         color.highlight.background = color.background,
         color.highlight.border = color.border) %>% 
  mutate(borderWidth = 2,
         id = row_number(),
         title = name)


edge_list <- edge_list %>%
  mutate(PaperID     = match(Paper,     nodes$name),
         ReferenceID = match(Reference, nodes$name))

edges <- data.frame(
  from   = edge_list$PaperID,
  to     = edge_list$ReferenceID,
  arrows = "to",
  smooth = TRUE,
  shadow = TRUE
)

```


```{r wc, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-dpi: 72

library(rentrez)
library(xml2)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(reactable)
library(tm)
library(topicmodels)
library(tidytext)
library(ggwordcloud)
library(visNetwork)

top_terms <- tidy(lda_model, matrix = "beta") %>%
  group_by(topic, term) %>% 
  summarise(beta = sum(beta)) %>% 
  slice_max(beta, n = 15) |> 
  mutate(color = topic_colors[as.character(topic)])
  

set.seed(2024)
ggplot(top_terms, aes(label = term, size = beta, alpha = beta, color = color)) +
  geom_text_wordcloud() +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 10) +
  facet_wrap(~topic) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.85, 1)) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  theme(
      strip.text.x = element_blank()
      )

# The network stays fixed (no dragging or zooming) so it cannot be moved out of
# sight. Clicking a paper filters the table below to it; clicking empty space
# shows all papers again.
visNetwork(nodes, edges) %>%
  visLayout(randomSeed = 2024) %>%
  visInteraction(dragView = FALSE, zoomView = FALSE, dragNodes = FALSE) %>%
  visEvents(
    selectNode = "function(p) {
      var paper = this.body.data.nodes.get(p.nodes[0]);
      Reactable.setSearch('papers-table', paper.name);
      document.getElementById('papers-table').scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start'});
    }",
    deselectNode = "function(p) { Reactable.setSearch('papers-table', undefined); }"
  )

```



```{r papertable, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}


library(rentrez)
library(xml2)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(reactable)
library(tm)
library(topicmodels)
library(tidytext)
library(ggwordcloud)
library(visNetwork)

pub_data <- bind_rows(pub_data_org, orcid_data) %>% filter(Date > filt_year,
                                !(Type %in% c('Preprint', 'Published Erratum', "Editorial"))) %>%
  arrange(desc(Date)) %>%
  mutate(
    Auth = paste(map_chr(Author, extract_first_two), '...', map_chr(Author, extract_last)),
    Year = year(Date)
  ) %>%
  relocate(Auth, .after = 'Author') %>% 
  select(-Date)

paper_url <- ifelse(is.na(pub_data$doi),
                    paste0("https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/", pub_data$pmid, "/"),
                    paste0("https://doi.org/", pub_data$doi))

reactable(pub_data %>% select(-Auth, -Abstract, -pmid, -doi, -Type, -main_auth), searchable = TRUE,
          elementId = "papers-table",
          language = reactableLang(searchPlaceholder = "Search papers by title, author, journal or year..."),
          defaultPageSize = 20,
          pageSizeOptions = c(10, 20, 50, 100),
          defaultColDef = colDef(
            style = list(fontSize = "17px", color = "#000")
          ),
          theme = reactableTheme(
            cellPadding = "12px 10px",
            headerStyle = list(fontSize = "18px")
          ),
          columns = list(Title = colDef(minWidth = 500, style = list(fontSize = "19px", lineHeight = "1.45"),
                                        cell = function(value, index) {
                                          htmltools::tags$a(href = paper_url[index], target = "_blank", value)
                                        }),
                         # authors hidden to give titles more room, but still searchable
                         Author = colDef(show = FALSE, searchable = TRUE),
                         Journal = colDef(minWidth = 260, style = list(fontSize = "17px", lineHeight = "1.4", color = "#000")),
                         Year = colDef(width = 85)),
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE, filterable = TRUE,
          details = function(index) {
            htmltools::div(class = "paper-details",
              htmltools::p(htmltools::strong("Authors: "), pub_data$Author[index]),
              if (!is.na(pub_data$Abstract[index]))
                htmltools::p(htmltools::strong("Abstract: "), pub_data$Abstract[index])
            )
          })

```
